<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="1003.0" y="1188" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="1003.0" dy="0">Output</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="1216" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">Declared module scope; source code and kernels are not executed.</tspan>
<tspan x="600.0" dy="16.52">Different parameter paths own independent weights; colors express operation roles.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="1320" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="1350" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="1375" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
